summary.name: ResourceSpace
summary.one_liner: ResourceSpace is an open-source digital asset management project, and this page gives the Subversion and Git commands for downloading its stable releases and development code.
use_cases: download the latest stable ResourceSpace release
summary.what_it_does: This page explains how to obtain ResourceSpace source code. Stable releases are checked out from the Subversion repository using svn co with a version number. The development trunk is available via Subversion or by git clone from the GitHub repository. Release branches exist only on Subversion for now, so the page shows how to fetch them with git-svn. It also states that contributors submit initial patches and must sign a Contributor License Agreement before getting write access.
notable: Stable releases available via Subversion; trunk development code on both Subversion and GitHub
Release branches are Subversion-only, accessed via git-svn bridge
Contributors must sign a Contributor License Agreement
caveats: Development code is described as untested and unstable
Release branches are not yet on GitHub; project is moving fully to GitHub
Subversion write access requires several accepted patches first
